test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 09 Oct, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Five girls P, Q, R, S and T sit around a circular table facing towards the centre (not necessarily in the same order). Only one girl sits between S and T. P sits to the immediate left of R. P is not an immediate neighbour of S.

Who sits third to the right of T?
solution: Given: Five girls P, Q, R, S and T sit around a circular table facing towards the centre. 1) P sits to the immediate left of R. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fd4c6d147804d4fe8e71e7d61e3611754d700ad565b639262a60e8cc9a4de328.png]
